analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold, rising from 21.2 to 34.1. MACD histogram also improves from -6.6938 to -2.5961, signaling bottoming. 5-day low ($277.07) slightly higher than 20-day low ($276.92) suggests potential Higher Low pattern. However, below SMA20 ($314.29) and low volume (0.56x) lack conviction for trend reversal. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
